prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A3 prescribed display paths with independently selected positive radii, frequencies, phases, and axial/transverse decompositions; no path evolution or physical certification is implied.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0 selects the mutually orthogonal near-rest endpoint, with binary orbit planes yz, xz, and xy in the declared relative frame.
Every binary midpoint is the braid origin in the relative frame; each positive h_a separates the two endpoint orbit centers along the binary axis while rho_a^2+h_a^2=R_a^2.
The zero group translation, radii, frequencies, phases, axial half-separations, and circulation signs are illustrative coordinates permitted by A3.
Normalized linear axis interpolation defines the wider taxonomy path but does not alter this near-rest representative.
